message: `tv_break` was given but `tv` was not; there is nothing for it to split
`tv_break` has length 2 but `times` has 3; it is one value per observation
`tv` column 1 changes inside a block of group '1' that `tv_break` says is constant. The break column decides where the solve is split, so every `tv` value has to hold over the whole block
group '1' has two observations at time 1 that disagree about a `tv` value. A time-varying input is a step function of time, so one time cannot carry two values
`parms` is NULL or empty and `tv` was not given, so the dynamics has no parameters at all. Pass the constants in `parms`, the time-varying ones in `tv`

`tv` carries an estimated quantity, so its change points cannot be read off its values: RTMB refuses comparison on AD types. Pass `tv_break`, the data column whose changes within a group are the change points
`tv_break` is an estimated quantity. frm_ode() needs it as data: it fixes the solve grid, which is built before the tape. Estimated event times are not supported

Nonlinear parameter 'lk' is a dynamics input of frm_ode() but is not constant within 'id': phaselate. One system is solved per group and every dynamics input is read off the group's first row, so a term that varies within a group cannot enter the likelihood - the fit would leave its coefficient at t
